question: In a certain code language, ‘BLOWER’ is coded as ‘PDUNJA’. What is the code for ‘BLUFFS’ in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'BLOWER' is coded as 'PDUNJA',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fbab742c4d6c4c897a1f6ca619141ae8c18e6319ca5b81fb47bf000f8dedff.png] 

Similarly, for 'BLUFFS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/216c5f40ae1e7af62e8793f50f643b1894d9753a7cdf21f3dc2eb515e0dd533b.png]
